development.algorithm: lowest SHA256(UTF-8(seed|series_id)), tie by series_id; output sorted

protocol.feature_availability: sales <= row.origin_d; prices from completed weeks <= row.origin_d; future calendar assumed known
protocol.hierarchy_development: induced aggregates over sampled leaves only, never full-M5 aggregates
protocol.test_policy: Tune using validation_1..3 only; freeze configuration before test; forecast has no labels
protocol.training_row_filter: origin_d < split.origin_d AND target_d >= train_start_d AND target_d <= train_end_d
